914b1716: The ISEE certificate is valid until 31 December of the year you request it: from 1 January a new DSU (single substitute declaration) is needed. This is not a formality: without an up-to-date ISEE the single allowance automatically drops to the minimum and social bonuses, reduced nursery and canteen fees, scholarships and housing lists all stay blocked. The DSU is filed free of charge through a CAF or a patronato, or online on the INPS site with SPID or CIE; much of the data is already pre-filled. It is best done in the first weeks of January, when the offices are less crowded: you will need ID documents for everyone in the household, tax codes, the tenancy agreement or mortgage details, and the account balances as at 31 December two years earlier.

98a0c875: From 3 August 2026 paper identity cards stop being valid across the European Union, even if the document shows a later expiry date. From that day they are no longer good for identifying yourself in Italy or for travelling abroad. If you still have the paper document you must ask your municipality for the Electronic Identity Card (CIE), which can be requested at any time: you book an appointment at the registry office, you need a passport photo, the old document and your tax code, and the CIE arrives by post within a few days. Book early: close to the deadline, council appointments run out. The CIE also works as a digital identity for logging into public websites.
